rounds.text: Umiya Mobile Ltd presents a compelling value case, trading at a modest P/E of 7.84x [E1] and a price-to-book ratio of 1.49x [E2], while offering an extraordinary margin of safety of 80.4% relative to an intrinsic value of Rs 258 per share [E28, E29]. The company exhibits elite capital efficiency, boasting a ROCE of 31.0% [E6] and an ROE of 29.5% [E7], alongside a robust 3-year median ROE of 35% [E13] that comfortably surpasses the sector median ROCE of 8.7% [E46]. Growth momentum is exceptional, driven by a 36% compounded sales growth over 3 years [E8], a 39% expansion in trailing twelve-month sales [E9], and a staggering 271% compounded profit growth over the same 3-year span [E10]. Furthermore, fundamental health is reinforced by conservative financing, featuring a low debt-to-equity ratio of 0.12x [E22] and a dramatic reduction in borrowings from Rs 24 Cr to Rs 6 Cr [E23], complemented by strong promoter skin-in-the-game at 73.80% [E25]. Conceded: [E4], [E15], [E18], [E36].
